svg.title: Blueprint 5 — 50MP Image Downscaling, 3-Tier AI Vision/OCR Waterfall & 7-Tier Cover Pipeline
svg.desc: Two-band architecture diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing Sub-Pipeline A (client 50MP downscaling, 100MP pixel bomb guard, 3-tier Gemini/Ollama/Tesseract waterfall, LLMTelemetry audit) and Sub-Pipeline B (7-tier manifestation cover acquisition and perceptual hash junk rejection).
svg.text: Blueprint 5 — 50MP Image Downscaling, 3-Tier AI Vision/OCR Waterfall & 7-Tier Cover Pipeline
iqoqo v1.2.0 • Client Pre-Resize, Pixel Bomb Guard, Multimodal Extraction, LLMTelemetry & Perceptual Hash Filtering

g.text: • Normalizes EXIF/RGB (<=2000px) → Structured Book & Serial JSON:
Title, Authors, ISSN, Indeks, IssueNumber, Volume, CoverHeadline
• Zero-cloud local inference fallback with configurable OLLAMA_VISION_TIMEOUT
• Auto-probes localhost:11434 vs host.docker.internal:11434 in Docker
Always Available: Executes even when ALLOW_LLM=false (Zero Cloud/GPU)
• Crops full cover + masthead/top-corners + barcode strip via Pillow
• Regex parses: ISSN, Indeks, Nr X(Y), /YYYY, PL/EN months & 977 OCR
Records every Vision/OCR & AI Cover run:

svg.text: SYNC FAST LOOKUP → ASYNC CELERY → PIL FALLBACK
